title: A kurucok felkelése és hadviselése (The Kurucok Rise Up)
grammar: Two Things at Once: míg and miközben

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe how the Kuruc uprising began and how the Kuruc army fought.
I can describe two things happening at once using míg and miközben.
I can say who the Kuruc and the labanc were and what the Kuruc light cavalry did.
I can use eight new words about the Kuruc uprising and its way of fighting.
